tasks.title: Proposals for RQ-LHW-1877bb: low-storage low-Hamming-weight DLP at sqrt(binom(m, w)) time

Known as reported: meet-in-the-middle on the weight reaches that time WITH storage of the same order; polynomial-memory methods (KN-LIT-4794, Esser-May nested collision finding and representations) are reported at a worse exponent. H-ICEX-8f9ea2 and EXP-ICEX-850e41 already treat W(m, w) as a promise class and measure T(W); name them in discriminated_from with the exact delta (storage is the object here, not the time exponent alone).

tasks.title: Proposals for RQ-FROB-7d8dd4: Frobenius exploitation in subfield-curve index calculus

handoff.objective: Generate one or two schema-complete proposals bound to RQ-FROB-7d8dd4: whether the q-power Frobenius endomorphism of a subfield curve E/F_q attacked over F_{q^n} reduces the fully charged cost of index calculus by more than the trivial constant factors (n on the factor base via Frobenius orbits, n^2 on linear algebra), specifically whether a Frobenius-invariant rewriting of the summation-polynomial decomposition system after Weil descent lowers the solving degree or the number of variables, and whether the charged pipeline beats Pollard rho on Frobenius classes (the sqrt(n) speedup) at toy scale. The null object is mandatory: a curve over F_{q^n} not defined over any proper subfield at matched size, subgroup order and factor-base size, through the identical pipeline. Candidate shapes: (i) a mechanism proposal on the invariant-ring rewriting of the descended Semaev system under the Frobenius action (and its composition with the negation symmetry), predicting a solving-degree or variable-count difference between object and null object with a minimal test at small (q, n, m) using a Groebner or SAT decider already used in this program; (ii) a measurement proposal that charges every stage on both arms and reports the Frobenius gain stage by stage against the predicted constants, with the accelerated rho baseline. GHS Weil descent is prior art to be named and used as a comparison row where its applicability conditions hold, not rediscovered. Deployed Koblitz curves are never instances.
